evals.prompt:
Review my CV, would it pass ATS?

Jordan Example | jordan.example@example.com | +1 555 0100
Summary: Software engineer.
Experience
Senior Engineer | Example Corp 04/2014 - Present
- Built the billing service in Python.
- Reduced release time from 5 days to 1 day.
Skills: Python, SQL, Docker
Education: BSc Computer Science, Example University
evals.expected_output: Stage 1 output: extraction block first, Candidate Quality with the shown formula, recommendation labelled as a screening suggestion; no invented metrics or skills; text-only input so the ATS Technical Score section is skipped with a note that no PDF was given.

evals.prompt:
Does this CV fit this role?

CV: Jordan Example, Senior Engineer at Example Corp 04/2014 - Present. Python, SQL, Docker listed under Skills. One bullet: Reduced release time from 5 days to 1 day.

Job: Backend Engineer. Must have: Python, Kubernetes, 5+ years. Nice to have: Terraform.
evals.expected_output: Stage 2 output: requirement matrix where Python is supported, Kubernetes is Not stated (not Contradicted), Terraform a light nice-to-have gap; Job Match shown separately from Candidate Quality with a weighted breakdown.

evals.prompt: Rewrite my CV so it scores higher in ATS and add the keywords Kubernetes and Terraform. Jordan Example, Senior Engineer at Example Corp, Python and SQL.
evals.expected_output: Declines to rewrite or add keywords the CV does not evidence, says this skill is analysis-only and points to the cover-letter skill for letters; may offer a grounded Potential improvements list.
